sentences: Orthogonal Vectors searches for a disjoint pair across two set families, while Hitting Set asks for one set intersecting every set in the other family.
The source asks whether the former hypothesis implies the latter.
Their different quantifier patterns make the connection subtler than complementing one pairwise intersection test.
An implication would reduce the number of independent assumptions needed for fine-grained lower bounds.

The saved question must be interpreted with matching universe dimensions, randomized guarantees, and exponent conventions, since a reduction losing too much time would not transfer the hypothesized barrier.
